tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Generic connector fetch: the full Thea entry for an id from search, as Markdown text (fields, links, recent records, sources, licence). thea_entry returns the same entry as JSON.

tools.name: thea_search
tools.description: Find one entry whose name you know, or a shop with its area ('퇴촌 맘스터치'). Thea is curated by people, not a search engine: it returns a trimmed entry (about 1,000 characters) you may use as it is. tools.description: Browse by conditions when you have no name. Questions like 'camping YouTubers who posted a new video recently' or 'hotels in 서귀포' cannot be answered by thea_search. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "thea_search" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
